emptyDescription: Import an M3U or TXT playlist and its channels will appear here.
openFailedDescription: The channel library could not be opened.
noFavoritesDescription: Tap the heart on a channel card and it stays in this list.
epgSourceHint: An XMLTV or JSON guide URL
epgEmpty: No guide sources yet; import one and the channel cards show what is on.
activeGuideDescription: The guide source used for the channel list; one at a time.
activeGuideCardHint: The channel list's “on air” and progress follow this guide.
autoUpdateHint: Checks in the background at this interval and refetches guides with auto-update on.
customUserAgentDesc: User-Agent for imports and playback; blank means the app default.
autoUpdateStatusOn: {count: int} guides refresh at this interval
deleteActiveGuideNote: This guide is in use; another source takes over after deletion.
deleteGuideMessage: Delete the guide “{name: String}”? Its downloaded guide data is removed too.
deletePlaylistMessage: Delete “{name: String}” and its {count: int} channels?
importGuideDescription: XMLTV URLs or files; the guide is downloaded after import.
importInvalid: The content is not a valid playlist
importNetworkFailed: The network request failed; check the address or proxy
importPlaylistDescription: M3U/M3U8/TXT from a URL, a file or pasted text.
noSourcesDescription: Import a playlist or a guide and it appears here.
noPlaylistsDescription: Import a playlist from a URL, a file or pasted text.
playlistNameHint: Leave blank to name it from the source
replaceMessage: A playlist with this name exists; the imported content replaces it.
sourceChanged: The source changed; the cache was updated
summarySources: {playlists: int} playlists · {guides: int} guides · {channels: int} channels
orderHint: Drag the grip or use the arrows; the saved order is how the list shows.
playerNoStream: This channel has no stream address
sourceAddressOpenFailed: The address could not be opened
autoSyncDesc: Updates silently in the background at a cold start.
browseChannelNumberDesc: Prints the dial number beside the channel name.
browseReverseDesc: Makes the up key step down the list and the down key step up.
browseClockDesc: Draws the current clock beside the title while a channel plays.
browseProgrammeLineDesc: Shows the current or next programme under the channel name.
groupsEmpty: No groups yet — import a playlist first.
groupsHint: Switching a group off takes it out of the lists and the zapping; switching it back returns the same line-up.
recentClearDesc: Only this device's records are deleted; favourites and channels stay.
recentEmptyDescription: Channels you play appear here, so you can jump back to what was on.
favouritesEmptyDescription: Tap the favourite mark in the channel list and it appears here.
zapperHint: Arrow keys to move, OK to play or replay, back to close.
importClipboardFound: The clipboard holds a link or a list
importScanHint: Fill in the name and the link on a phone; the preview opens as soon as it arrives.
importScanReceived: Received from the phone — check it below
importXtreamNote: The live channels are imported from the account's playlist address; the password is part of that address.
importXtreamCheckFailed: The panel could not be checked; importing may still work
presetRestored: Default sources restored; add them again from Recommended
previewGroupPick: Choose the groups to show (the others are hidden after the import, and can be shown again)
previewGuideNoMatch: Matches none of your channels; try another guide
previewGuideStale: This guide has stopped updating: every programme ends before {end}, so nothing will be on air
previewUrlClash: This address is already imported; “{name}” will be updated
failureHttpStatus: The server answered with an error (HTTP {code: int})
failureTimeout: The server did not answer in time
failureUnreachable: The server could not be reached; check the address and the network
failureWebPage: A web page came back instead of a playlist; check the link (use the raw address on GitHub)
failureGuideFile: This is a guide; import it under the Guide tab
failureNoChannels: No channels were read; make sure this is an M3U/TXT playlist
failureTruncated: The content is incomplete (the download was cut off); try again
failureUnreadable: The file cannot be read, or its text encoding is not supported
failureNameTaken: That name belongs to another source
deleteImpactNote: The {channels: int} channels only it lists go with it ({favourites: int} of them favourites)
deleteImpactNone: Its channels are shared with other sources and stay
deletePresetNote: This is a built-in source; it is not re-added automatically. Add it again from Recommended.
emptyStartDescription: Add a recommended source to start watching, or import your own list from an address or a file.
importOriginLinkDesc: An M3U/TXT address that can sync any time
importOriginFileDesc: Pick an m3u/m3u8/txt file on this device
importOriginScanDesc: Type the address on a phone and send it here
importOriginXtreamDesc: Import live channels with a panel address and account
importGuideOriginLinkDesc: An XMLTV/JSON address that can update itself
importGuideOriginFileDesc: Pick an xml/xml.gz/json file on this device
importLinkHint: GitHub page links become their raw file address and go through your GitHub accelerator.
importFileFormats: .m3u .m3u8 .txt; UTF-8, GBK and UTF-16 are detected
previewIdleBody: Choose a source and press Preview: the channels, groups and problems are listed first, and nothing is written until you confirm.
